tasks.gr9-listening-speaking-t3: Topic: Debate, prepared speeches, oral response to literature, and panel discussion. Cover argumentation structure, evidence presentation, literary interpretation, discussion protocols, and respectful disagreement. Ask Grade 9 learners to construct sound arguments, support claims with evidence, interpret literature orally, participate effectively in panels, and counter-argue respectfully.
tasks.gr9-reading-viewing-t3: Topic: Drama, poetry, short stories, message extraction, tone analysis, and character motivation. Cover dramatic text analysis, poetic device identification, narrative interpretation, underlying message detection, tone establishment, and motivation inference. Ask Grade 9 learners to analyze dramatic scenes, identify poetic techniques, interpret story messages, explain character choices, and support interpretations with textual evidence.
tasks.gr9-writing-presenting-t3: Topic: Discursive paragraph, formal letter, article writing, project work, and presentation skills. Cover multi-perspective discussion, formal letter conventions, article purpose and audience, project research and organization, and presentation delivery. Ask Grade 9 learners to present balanced viewpoints, write formal correspondence, tailor articles to audience, develop projects thoroughly, and deliver presentations effectively.
tasks.gr9-language-structures-t3: Topic: Complex sentences, subordinating conjunctions, punctuation refinement, editing skills, and vocabulary enhancement. Cover clause relationships, conjunction usage, advanced punctuation, error correction, and word choice precision. Ask Grade 9 learners to construct complex sentences, use subordinators appropriately, apply advanced punctuation, identify and correct errors, and choose precise vocabulary.
